scope.zh: 把数据中心用电预测、电网价格信号、一个具体站点和供应链公司的说法放在一起。本页不含逐站点完整名单、PUE 或水资源数据。
scope.en: Data-centre electricity forecasts, grid price signals, one concrete site and what supply-chain companies said, side by side. It does not include a complete site list, PUE or water data.

primary-read.zh: 已打开并阅读官方原文。
primary-read.en: Official primary document opened and read.

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方来源，细节取自搜索摘要，未逐字核对。
primary-located.en: Official source located; details come from search summaries, not checked verbatim.

secondary-authoritative.zh: 权威机构或行业组织的二手转述。
secondary-authoritative.en: Relayed by an authoritative body or trade press.

secondary.zh: 媒体或聚合站摘要，数字可能因口径或时点不同而冲突。
secondary.en: Press or aggregator summary; figures may conflict by scope or timing.

editorial.zh: 本站对财报问答与来源的编辑归纳，不是已核实结论。
editorial.en: This site’s editorial synthesis of Q&A and sources; not a verified conclusion.

title.zh: IEA《能源与AI》：2030年数据中心用电约945 TWh
title.en: IEA Energy and AI: data-centre electricity about 945 TWh by 2030

summary.zh: IEA 估计2024年数据中心用电约415 TWh（占全球约1.5%），基准情景2030年约945 TWh，2035年约1,200 TWh；AI优化数据中心用电到2030年增长逾四倍。
summary.en: The IEA estimates data-centre use at about 415 TWh in 2024 (about 1.5% of global electricity), about 945 TWh by 2030 and about 1,200 TWh by 2035 in its Base Case; AI-optimised data-centre demand more than quadruples by 2030.

facts.zh: 美国将贡献2030年前数据中心用电增量的近一半，中国次之。
facts.en: The US accounts for almost half of the growth to 2030, with China second.

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要；这是2025年4月的预测，之后是否更新未核实。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read; this is an April 2025 forecast and later updates were not checked.

title.zh: LBNL/DOE：美国数据中心2028年占电力6.7–12%
title.en: LBNL/DOE: US data centres 6.7–12% of electricity by 2028

summary.zh: 美国数据中心用电从2014年58 TWh增至2023年176 TWh（占4.4%）；2028年情景区间为325–580 TWh（占6.7–12%）。
summary.en: US data-centre use rose from 58 TWh in 2014 to 176 TWh in 2023 (4.4% of US electricity); the 2028 scenario range is 325–580 TWh (6.7–12%).

sources.label: LBNL 2024 US Data Center Energy Usage Report

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要；区间宽度本身说明预测不确定。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read; the width of the range itself shows the forecast uncertainty.

title.zh: PJM 2028/29 容量拍卖：第三次触顶 $325/MW-日
title.en: PJM 2028/29 capacity auction: third straight clearing at the $325/MW-day cap

summary.zh: 拍卖结果于2026年7月14日公布，出清价为法定上限$325/MW-日（上一次$333）；采购138,318 MW，仍比可靠性目标少6,831 MW。
summary.en: Results published 14 July 2026 cleared at the $325/MW-day cap (previous $333); 138,318 MW procured, still 6,831 MW short of the reliability target.

facts.zh: PJM 模拟无上限出清价为$555/MW-日；买方实付$16.4B，无上限为$29.7B。
facts.en: PJM’s uncapped simulation cleared at $555/MW-day; buyers pay $16.4B versus $29.7B uncapped.

facts.zh: 报道称上限延至12月举行的2030/31拍卖；峰值预测到2036年上调约66,000 MW，主要来自退役、电气化与拟建数据中心。
facts.en: Reports say the cap extends to the December 2030/31 auction; peak forecasts rose by about 66,000 MW by 2036, driven by retirements, electrification and proposed data centres.

caveat.zh: 未读 PJM 原始公告；把短缺归因于数据中心的是倡导机构与媒体判断，不是 PJM 的成本分摊结论。
caveat.en: PJM’s own notice was not read; attributing the shortfall to data centres is a view of advocacy groups and press, not a PJM cost-allocation finding.

title.zh: Stargate Abilene：0.3–0.6 GW在运行，目标1.2 GW
title.en: Stargate Abilene: 0.3–0.6 GW operating, 1.2 GW target

summary.zh: Epoch AI 估计2026年春季 Abilene 站点已运行0.3至0.6 GW，目标约1.2 GW、预计2026年Q3前后完成；站点由 Crusoe 开发，8栋建筑，Oracle 称最终将容纳超过45万块 GB200。
summary.en: Epoch AI estimates Abilene was operating 0.3–0.6 GW in spring 2026 against a 1.2 GW target due around Q3 2026; developed by Crusoe, eight buildings, and Oracle says it will eventually hold more than 450,000 GB200 GPUs.

facts.zh: 2026年3月报道称计划中的600 MW扩建被取消，Oracle 对此表述提出异议；供电为电网加天然气涡轮。
facts.en: Reports in March 2026 said a planned 600 MW expansion was dropped, which Oracle disputes; power comes from grid plus natural-gas turbines.

sources.label: Epoch AI: OpenAI Stargate, where the US sites stand

caveat.zh: 各来源对“当前已运行容量”不一致；0.6 GW是估计。其他 Stargate 站点未覆盖。
caveat.en: Sources disagree on current operating capacity and 0.6 GW is an estimate. Other Stargate sites are not covered.

title.zh: 电力与场地约束：设备、托管与新云怎么说
title.en: Power and site constraints: what equipment, colocation and neocloud firms said

summary.zh: Equinix 称电力是最大约束，并披露了合同或后期阶段电力安排；CoreWeave 的延误来自带电厂房而非电力；Digital Realty 与 Equinix 都没有给出逐年已通电功率或已签公用事业协议的占比；Schneider 称设备交付周期总体已正常化；Vertiv 则称交付时点因项目复杂性与上下游依赖而漂移。
summary.en: Equinix called power the largest constraint and described contracted or advanced-stage power; CoreWeave’s delays were powered-shell delivery, not power; Digital Realty and Equinix did not give year-by-year energised power or the share with executed utility agreements; Schneider said equipment lead times had generally normalised while Vertiv cited timing shifts from project complexity and supply interdependencies.

facts.zh: Eaton、Schneider 都在讨论高压直流（HVDC）架构的渐进铺开。
facts.en: Eaton and Schneider both discuss a gradual rollout of higher-voltage DC architectures.

caveat.zh: 编辑归纳，来自站内财报问答；公司之间口径不同，不构成行业统计。
caveat.en: Editorial synthesis from the site’s earnings Q&A; companies use different bases, so this is not an industry statistic.
